entry.summary: Temporary Road Closure - SH51 Napier to Awatoto due to road marking and sign installation works. There will be a road closure of SH51 between the intersections of Waitangi Road and Ellison Street Sunday 17 October - Monday 18 October, 7.00pm - 6.00am.
